Be among the first onboard Oguz Khan. She is crossing the Atlantic for her first Caribbean season, and her calendar is still open.

She was launched in 2026 and this is her first winter in the Caribbean. 50.5 metres, 6 cabins, up to 12 guests, 1 group.

The first 5 confirmed Caribbean charters open the season, from €125,100 per wee (cut off)
headline: Be Among the First Onboard
whyItWorks: It sells exclusivity and first-mover status, framing the opening week as something that can only be claimed once. Concrete specs and a starting price qualify buyers quickly, so only serious high-end prospects respond. The aerial footage of a tender and wake gives a taste of the lifestyle, and the soft call to share dates keeps the ask low-pressure.
